en: Xiaoxue: I hear there's a pastry in the Central Plains called Peace Cake. It sounds delicious. Could you buy me one?
OK, I'll go buy you one.

Xiaoxue: Art makes us poems, love makes us gods; both are wishful thinking. We love only our own wishes and illusions. You may not be pretty or polished, but you're rich inside - think how many rush through life with empty souls.
Got it! Here you go.
Xiaoxue: Thanks! Yummy!
Xiaoxue: What, you still haven't found a Peace Cake?
Phew... going right now.
Code Nut: Ha, BBK's RPG dev kit got upgraded again, but my computer's broken. Could you copy it from Bug onto a USB stick for me?

Code Nut: There's a thing called a motto: a sharp sentence wrapped like a soft-centered candy, sweet and warm. I found my own. It goes: When you're unhappy, try to be happy; believe that everything now is Heaven's best plan for you.
Phew, copied it. Here's your stick!
Code Nut: Thanks~
Code Nut: What, can't find Bug? Bug lives in the southeast of the Central Plains.
Wise Elder: Since I moved to the West I haven't seen my grandson. Could you take him this letter? He's called Mingming.
Wise Elder: Depressed, so depressed. I know I shouldn't be, but I can't find a reason for it.
Wise Elder: My grandson lives in the northwest of the Central Plains. Thank you, young hero.
Charmer: I hear there's a very fragrant flower in the Central Plains. Could you pick me a few?
Charmer: I like a simple life, so simple there's no suspense: the purest motives, the most basic feelings, free and easy... facing the sea, with spring blossoms. That's happiness.
Charmer: You picked some? Sorry to put you to the trouble!
Charmer: Still haven't found any? They say they only grow in the Central Plains.
Ah Xiu: Sigh. My little sister Xiaohong had a fight with Father and ran off, who knows where. Could you help me find her?
Ah Xiu: I'm searching for my first love, my oldest feelings; I'm waiting for the flair I once had, a future not far away. He's one of a kind.
Ah Xiu: Sigh... Xiaohong, honestly. A fight is no reason to run away from home.
Ah Xiu: You found her? Really? Thank you so much.
Super Jay Fan: You got it? Thank you so much!
Super Jay Fan: HELLO, I hear Jay's new album <Yeh Hui-Mei> is out. Could you buy me one at the Central Plains mall?
Super Jay Fan: Thanks a million, I'll be waiting.
Super Jay Fan: Quick, use the nunchucks! Hng hng ha hei!
Waaah, my poor ears.
SSK: Skip the small jobs and you'll toil at smaller ones.
SSK: Hurry up and take it to him.
A Water Demon's turned up on Mt. Hua, and the Huashan Big Brother asked me to bring him some Tianshan holy water.
SSK: Ah! Sure! One sec!
THANK YOU!
SSK: What? Flybug, that kid? Lately he's been digging some secret tunnel. Says he'll store oil and make a killing when World War Three breaks out.
Sheesh... now that's class!
SSK: Heh! He's a real master, you know.
Could he be the man the villagers talked about? The one with the mysterious martial arts?
SSK: Yep, that's him.
So how do I find him?

SSK: He's in the North. Exactly where? Find his tunnel. In the tunnel is a tunnel, in that is another tunnel, and in that, a hidden tunnel. If fate lets you find him, he might teach you a peerless art~
How exciting! I'm off.
SSK: False false true true, true true false false, true in false, false in true... false = true, true = false!
Ugh! So is it false = true or true = false?
HELLO, are you SSK?
SSK: Mm, that's me. What's up?
SSK: Wow? Really? That's great, thanks.
SSK: I know, thanks for telling me.
System: You've already done in the Wushan Two!
Old Codger: Ha ha, I'm Old Codger of the Wushan Two.
Codger Old: Ha ha, I'm Codger Old of the Wushan Two.
Old Codger: Halt! Who are you!
The man who's come for your heads!
Codger Old: Hell! You barge onto my turf and act this cocky!
Old Codger, Codger Old: Kill!
Wushan Two: Who'd have thought we'd die by your hand!
Die! Phew, I finally avenged him!
Shopaholic: I think it must be somewhere in the house. Could you help me look? Thanks.
Shopaholic: Five hundred glances back in a past life buy one brush of shoulders in this one.
Shopaholic: Ah! The thing I just bought is gone! Could you help me find it?
Ha, found it. Is this it?
Shopaholic: Ha, that's it! Thank you. Here's your reward.
Old Granny: My poor daughter, so bright and clever, pretty as a flower......
Old Granny: Such bad luck these past few days!
What's wrong, Granny?
Old Granny: Young man! Could you do me a favor?
Sure!
Old Granny: Kill someone for me!
Old Granny: Kill the bad guys!
Phew~ Say so, then! What bad guys?
Old Granny: A huge gang of bandits. They've killed lots of people, officials and plenty of martial artists too. They even ripped off SSK's classmate's family jewels!
Sheesh... they're that bad!
Old Granny: Sigh! They're the ones who took my daughter. My poor daughter, so bright and clever, pretty as a flower......
OK, OK, I'll help you!
Old Granny: 80% chance they're hiding underground, maybe in some house!
Old Granny: 80% chance they're hiding in the North, maybe in some house! Please hurry!
Old Granny: Oh! Thank you so much, young hero!
Heh~ No problem!
Girl: Young hero, thanks for saving me.
Ha ha, piece of cake. Don't mention it.
System: What do you want to do?
Court Propose Just-looking
System: Affection goes by how many flowers you give. You can carry only one at a time; any extras get deleted automatically.
System: Your Affection with the girl went up by one.
System: Affection is maxed out. It can't go any higher!
System: No roses, and you want to build Affection? OUT!
Beautiful, will you marry me?
Girl: Mm...
Ha ha, that's a yes?
System: Go to the Matchmaker's and get married.
System: Not enough Affection to propose!
System: The Affection range is above 0 and below 100.
Girl: Take care, young hero.
Wife: Honey, what would you like to do?
Bridal-chamber Rest Knit-gear Nothing
System: The bridal chamber costs 10 Essence Points a time. Go ahead?
Bridal chamber
Nothing came of the night in the bridal chamber...
Your daughter is born...
Wife: You're fully rested now.
System: You already have a daughter. This game strictly forbids a second child!
System: Not enough Essence Points for the bridal chamber.
Wife: Knitting gear takes 10 Frog Cloth. Want me to knit you something?
Yes please
Wife: Ouch, I pricked my hand...
Your wife hurt her hand. The knitting failed.
Wife: Honey, how can I knit you clothes without any cloth?
Old Wu: The road of life must be walked step by step, by those who set their hearts on it.
System: You've entered the Haunted House. Whooo...
Whoa, this place looks seriously creepy.
System: You've met a ghost. Fight it?
Fight
Ghost: Who are you? What are you doing here?
Whoa, there really is a ghost! Take this!
Servant: Ah! Thank you for saving this house. I'll tell you a secret, but first you must solve a riddle: what is the relation between false and true?
Fake=fake,real=real
I don't know
Servant: Congratulations!
Servant: Wrong!
Servant: How honest you are! Then I'll tell you: there's a huge maze in this house, and Flybug lives in it.
System: The ghost beat you. GAME OVER!
Servant: Ha ha! Not bad, it really is fate! All right, I'll let you in. Only those fate favors get to meet the master in the maze!
System: The bandits have already fled.
Bandit: Hahahaha...
Bandit: Give the password! The Heavenly King covers the earth tiger!
The pagoda holds down the river demon. (how corny can you get)
Bandit: Correct. Please enter your username and password.
Huh??? What?
Bandit: Wrong password, returning to the login page.
Sheesh~~! Let me in!!! Argh! Let me in! Let me in!
Bandit: The page cannot be displayed! Please refresh or check your network settings!
Ugh! Attack!
Bandit B: Ah! Intruder!
Bandit A: Everybody, kill him!
Bandit C: I'm coming!
Bandit D: I'll go report to the boss in East Gate Zone A31984! You guys fight first!
Bandit B: No way! I'm going!
Bandit A: You're wrong, it's East Gate Zone A31884!
Bandit C: You guys fight! I'm going!
Bandit D: Damn! Fine, you go to East Gate Zone A31884, you go to East Gate Zone A31894, you go to West Gate Zone U7482816. GO GO GO GO......
Sheesh...... are we fighting or not!
Bandit D: Sheesh, in the end I'm the one stuck fighting you!
Bandit B: I'm here! You're dead!
Bandit A: Me too!
Bandit C: Me too!
Whitemop, Brownmop: Kill!
Bandit: Brothers, scram!...
You open the cell door.
Miss, you can go now!
Girl: Ah... you're the one who saved me. Thank you!
Heh~ No problem! Hurry, go!
Girl: Let's go!
Mr. Yi, here's a letter my master asked me to deliver to you.
Yi Tianchou: Oh, sorry to trouble you. I've received the letter; you can go back and report.
Yi Tianchou: The dark night gave me dark eyes, yet I use them to seek the light.
Chengxin Electric: Only with courage and patience can you reach the light. However long the night, the day will come.
HELLO, are you Chengxin Electric?
Chengxin Electric: Mm, that's me. What's up?
Chengxin Electric: Wow? Really? That's great, thanks.
Chengxin Electric: I know, thanks for telling me.
Old Uncle: Ah, thank you so much. Here's your reward.
Old Uncle: Please, find me a pet egg.
Old Uncle: Young hero, could you give me a pet egg? I've been stuck here a long time and I'd like a pet for company.
Old Uncle: Young man, thank you.
Old Uncle: A man who understands romance is a good man; a man who doesn't is an even better one.
Xiaobao: Hey, little brother, I know a secret. Want to hear it? Give me 1000 yuan and it's yours.
Hear it
No thanks
Xiaobao: Heh heh, actually the secret I'm telling you is: I have no secret to tell you.
Damn, you're messing with me?
Xiaobao: Ha ha!
Xiaobao: Opportunity is a thief: it comes without a sound and leaves you robbed.
Xiaobao: Ha ha, if only everyone on Earth were as easy to fool as you.
Xiaobao: No money, and you want the biggest secret around? Get lost!
Tch, like I care. Someone like you couldn't know any big secret.
Xiaobao: !!! Don't you look down on me!
...If you really know one, let's hear it. If it's real, I'll take my hat off to you. If not...

Xiaobao: Listen up. Legend tells of a treasure that can trap demons, melting them into water. And it's real: lately the famous Tipsy Sword found where it is. But its guardian, the 'Fire Dragon Beast', wounded him, and he fled with his internal energy gone. He's healing at home; ask him. All he told me was that there's a sacred pool atop Bright Peak, and the treasure's hidden there.
Xiaobao: Well? That's a huge secret, right?
Mo Ming thinks: This kid's probably not lying. Father did tell me to go to Bright Peak, so why not grab the treasure on the way? Let me pump him for more.
How do I know you're telling the truth?
Xiaobao: Hmph, don't believe me? Go see Tipsy Sword in the East.
Oh, I'll be right back.
Xiaobao: ....If you go like that, he won't even look at you!
Oh? WHY?
Xiaobao: NO WHY!
Xiaobao: Fine, I'll tell you. You have to bring the famous wine Sevenmile, or he won't talk to you.
Ha, got it, thanks!
Ah Dai: Thank you. Here's your reward.
Ah Dai: Young hero, please buy me some Jade Fruit.
Ah Dai: Young hero, I've caught a cold. Could you buy me some Jade Fruit?
Ah Dai: Ah... ah... ACHOO! Sigh... colds are miserable.
PC Nut: Computers are my life!
Libai: Li Bai is my big brother, ha ha!
Shadow Pig: BBK is my home!
Chunlan Guardian: Life is full of contradictions; nobody can help it.
HELLO, are you Chunlan Guardian?
Chunlan Guardian: Mm, that's me. What's up?
Chunlan Guardian: Wow? Really? That's great, thanks.
Chunlan Guardian: I know, thanks for telling me.

Green Blight: Why!!

No way, you're that good~

Teach me!

Oh! Then make time for a PK!
Green Blight: You're on!

Red Blight: Sheesh... kid! They're gone. Better get going.
Oh! Shall we check the flowers next door?!?!
Master Xuanji: If my existence is a mistake, I'd rather keep making it.
Excuse me, are you Master Xuanji?
Master Xuanji: I am.
Bigeye asked me to ask you. He says he's dying.

?????Oh! I'll go tell him!

Shin-chan: Mr. Elephant, Mr. Elephant...

Zhuofeng: Could I cross the Milky Way to meet you? No distance scares me, I just long to race to your side. The past is smoke, you haunt my dreams; though I search ten thousand years, this life's love won't change!
Big Rabbit's mother is about to hang herself
Mother Rabbit: Heavens, why are you doing this to me!
I'll save...
Mother Rabbit: Why won't you let me die?
You're Big Rabbit's mom, right? Big Rabbit asked me to check on you... he misses you. His business is doing great. Why would you want to end it all?
Mother Rabbit: I'm so miserable. My son left, and now bandits have stolen our heirloom, the Glow Pearl. How am I supposed to go on?
Big Rabbit never meant to leave you... he just has his own dream. Once he has your blessing, he'll come back.
Mother Rabbit: All right. I won't stand in the way of his business... but what about the Glow Pearl?
I'll get it back for you... the bandits should still be in the Central Plains.
Mother Rabbit: Look for ways to succeed, not excuses for failing.
I'm back~ Oh~. Big Rabbit, you're here too~.
Big Rabbit: Mm. I'm back. I heard you got our Glow Pearl back for us... I don't know how to thank you...
No big deal~ Here's the Glow Pearl.
Mother Rabbit: Young man, thank you so much. This is the battle robe Big Rabbit's father left. It's no use to us. Please take it.
All right, I'll take it. I've got things to do, so I'll be off.
Mother Rabbit: Thank you for your trouble.

Dugu Zheng: So this is the Old Uncle's letter. Let's see... hm...... this... how? Wasn't that all over...
What's wrong?

Dugu Zheng: Hm... young hero! The Wushan Two (Old Codger and Codger Old) are the Old Uncle's sworn enemies. 30 years ago they killed his son, then next day seized his wife and beat his parents to death. He was away both times. He buried his parents in tears and went to Wushan to settle the score, knowing he couldn't win. On the mountain lay a pile of bones: his wife's. Enraged, he charged to the summit to fight to the death, but the Wushan Two were gone. Heartbroken, he settled on the east shore in peace. Now they're back, and he wants to go after them, only... over the years he's made peace with a lot; maybe it's fate. So he wrote asking what to do...... Young hero, what should I tell him?
Avenge him
Stay out of it
Hm.... let's back him. I'll help you get revenge on them!
Dugu Zheng: Thank you!
Dugu Zheng: Life is dear, love is dearer still; but for freedom's sake I'd give up both.
Dugu Zheng: Hm, you have a point.
Dugu Zheng: Oh, I've got the letter. Thank you.
Old Uncle: Young fellow, how did you get here? Want to cross the river?
Uh-huh!
Old Uncle: There are two gates over there, and you need keys to get through. Do me a favor and I'll give you two keys and a Fly Charm.
What favor?
Old Uncle: Take this letter to 'Dugu Zheng' nearby.
OK, no problem.
Old Uncle: Thank you.
Old Uncle: A miracle is a miracle because it doesn't happen often.

I delivered the letter, and I know what happened. I'll help you.

I won't know if I can beat them till I try! I'm off!
Old Uncle: Thanks!~ Be careful, young hero!
Old Uncle: Oh, the letter's delivered? Thank you.
